site.title: tact — Terminal-first AI coding agent
site.description: tact is a terminal-first AI coding agent built in Rust. Self-hosted, MIT licensed, extensible via MCP, skills, and hooks.

hero.subtitle: Built in Rust. MIT licensed. Your code never leaves your machine.

rust_binary.title: Native Rust binary
rust_binary.desc: ~15MB, no Electron, no Node.js. One binary, instant start.

self_hosted.title: Self-hosted by design
self_hosted.desc: Your API calls go direct. No cloud relay, no telemetry by default.

mit.title: MIT licensed
mit.desc: Truly open source. Fork, modify, redistribute without restrictions.

extensible.title: Extensible
extensible.desc: MCP servers · Custom skills · Hook system · 40+ built-in tools

agent_loop.title: Agent loop
agent_loop.desc: Streaming outputs, automatic context compaction, crash recovery. Run headless or interactive.

tools.title: 40+ tools
tools.desc: File I/O, Shell, LSP, Web search, Team messaging, Worktree isolation, Cron scheduling.

permissions.title: Permission modes
permissions.desc: Choose your safety level: default (ask per action), plan (review before execution), auto (fully autonomous).

subagents.title: Sub-agents & worktrees
subagents.desc: Spawn child agents in isolated git worktrees for parallel, sandboxed task execution.

mcp.title: Native MCP
mcp.desc: Use any MCP server as a tool provider. Extend tact with the growing MCP ecosystem.

step1.title: Install
step1.desc: Run the install script on Unix or Windows.

step2.title: Configure
step2.desc: Create a tact.toml in your project root.
